### LiveChartsSettings

Receiver: `LiveChartsSettings`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `AddMewTheme()` |  | Registers the MewUI default theme (palette, animation, tooltip and legend paints, and per-series rules) on the settings. |
| `UseMewDefaults()` |  | Registers the MewChartEngine, the MewUI theme and the default mappers on the settings, skipping each one that is already defined. |

### Series&lt;TModel, TVisual, TLabel&gt;

Receiver: `Series<TModel, TVisual, TLabel>`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `OnPointCreated(Action<ChartPoint<TModel, TVisual, TLabel>> predicate)` | `event PointCreated` | Executes the given action when a point is measured, this metod just subscribes to the PointCreated event, but with a simpler syntax. |
| `OnPointDown(ChartPointHandler<TModel, TVisual, TLabel> predicate)` | `event PointDown` | Executes the given action when a point is measured, this metod just subscribes to the ChartPointPointerDown event, but with a simpler syntax. |
| `OnPointHover(ChartPointHandler<TModel, TVisual, TLabel> predicate)` | `event PointHover` | Executes the given action when a point is measured, this metod just subscribes to the ChartPointPointerHover event, but with a simpler syntax. |
| `OnPointHoverLost(ChartPointHandler<TModel, TVisual, TLabel> predicate)` | `event PointHoverLost` | Executes the given action when a point is measured, this metod just subscribes to the ChartPointPointerHoverLost event, but with a simpler syntax. |
| `OnPointMeasured(Action<ChartPoint<TModel, TVisual, TLabel>> predicate)` | `event PointMeasured` | Executes the given action when a point is measured, this metod just subscribes to the PointMeasured event, but with a simpler syntax. |

### ChartViewBase

Receiver: `ChartViewBase` and derived types (`where T : ChartViewBase`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `AnimationsSpeed(TimeSpan value)` | `AnimationsSpeed` | Sets the duration of chart animations; defaults to AnimationsSpeed. |
| `AutoUpdateEnabled(bool value = true)` | `AutoUpdateEnabled` | Sets whether the chart updates itself when its data or properties change; the default is true. |
| `ChartTheme(Theme value)` | `ChartTheme` | Sets the theme applied to the chart; null (the default) uses the global LiveCharts theme. |
| `DrawMargin(Margin value)` | `DrawMargin` | Sets the margin between the control bounds and the plot area; null (the default) lets the chart compute it. |
| `Legend(IChartLegend value)` | `Legend` | Sets the legend listing the series; null (the default) uses the theme's default legend. |
| `LegendBackgroundPaint(Paint value)` | `LegendBackgroundPaint` | Sets the paint for the legend background; null uses the theme paint. |
| `LegendPosition(LegendPosition value)` | `LegendPosition` | Sets the legend position; defaults to LegendPosition. |
| `LegendTextPaint(Paint value)` | `LegendTextPaint` | Sets the paint for legend text; null uses the theme paint. |
| `LegendTextSize(double value)` | `LegendTextSize` | Sets the legend text size; a negative value (the default) uses the theme size. |
| `OnDataPointerDown(ChartPointsHandler handler)` | `event DataPointerDown` | Subscribes handler to DataPointerDown. Occurs when the pointer goes down over one or more chart points. |
| `OnHoveredPointsChanged(ChartPointHoverHandler handler)` | `event HoveredPointsChanged` | Subscribes handler to HoveredPointsChanged. Occurs when the set of hovered chart points changes. |
| `OnMeasuring(ChartEventHandler handler)` | `event Measuring` | Subscribes handler to Measuring. Occurs before the chart is measured, at the start of an update. |
| `OnUpdateFinished(ChartEventHandler handler)` | `event UpdateFinished` | Subscribes handler to UpdateFinished. Occurs when a chart update finishes. |
| `OnUpdateStarted(ChartEventHandler handler)` | `event UpdateStarted` | Subscribes handler to UpdateStarted. Occurs when a chart update starts. |
| `OnVisualElementsPointerDown(VisualElementsHandler handler)` | `event VisualElementsPointerDown` | Subscribes handler to VisualElementsPointerDown. Occurs when the pointer goes down over one or more visual elements. |
| `Series(IEnumerable<ISeries> value)` | `Series` | Sets the series plotted by the chart; the default is empty. |
| `SyncContext(object value)` | `SyncContext` | Sets the object locked while the chart measures and draws; defaults to a per-instance lock object. |
| `Title(IChartElement value)` | `Title` | Sets the title element drawn above the plot; null (the default) draws no title. |
| `Tooltip(IChartTooltip value)` | `Tooltip` | Sets the tooltip shown for hovered points; null (the default) uses the theme's default tooltip. |
| `TooltipBackgroundPaint(Paint value)` | `TooltipBackgroundPaint` | Sets the paint for the tooltip background; null uses the theme paint. |
| `TooltipPosition(TooltipPosition value)` | `TooltipPosition` | Sets the tooltip position relative to the hovered points; defaults to TooltipPosition. |
| `TooltipTextPaint(Paint value)` | `TooltipTextPaint` | Sets the paint for tooltip text; null uses the theme paint. |
| `TooltipTextSize(double value)` | `TooltipTextSize` | Sets the tooltip text size; a negative value (the default) uses the theme size. |
| `UpdaterThrottler(TimeSpan value)` | `UpdaterThrottler` | Sets the minimum interval between chart updates; defaults to UpdateThrottlingTimeout. |
| `VisualElements(IEnumerable<IChartElement> value)` | `VisualElements` | Sets the visual elements drawn over the chart; the default is empty. |
| `WithEasingFunction(Func<float, float> value)` | `EasingFunction` | Sets the easing function of chart animations; defaults to EasingFunction. |

| `ZoomingSpeed(double value)` | `ZoomingSpeed` | Sets the zooming speed from 0 (slowest) to 1 (fastest); defaults to ZoomSpeed. |

### PieChart

Receiver: `PieChart` and derived types (`where T : PieChart`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
